propositions: acli_graph.py hand-rolls the same nextPageToken cursor pagination loop three times with no runaway guard, allowing a server repeating the same token to spin indefinitely

A shared cursor iterator with runaway detection must raise RunawayPaginationError when the same non-null token appears twice consecutively, and this error must escape the fail-open exception handlers to prevent silent partial results

All three acli_graph pagination consumers must route through the shared iterator with no residual hand-rolled loops, and RunawayPaginationError must be caught ahead of the catch-all handler to preserve the degrade-open contract for ordinary faults
Offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages and jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) remain untouched and independent; cursor-based protocol consolidation is structurally separate
